Class List Here are the classes, structs, unions and interfaces with brief descriptions:CryoDeviceProxy.AppOptionsCryoDeviceProxy.Logs.CDPLoggerCryoDeviceProxy.CryoServerCryoDeviceProxy.BLL.Data
The class Data encapsulates the response to a ping packet from the server CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.DeviceBLL
The class DeviceBLL handles all communications with the backend server. CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.DeviceError
The class DeviceError encapsulates the error data information received from device CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.DeviceUsageStats
The class DeviceUsageStats encapsulates the usage statistics information received from device CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.InvalidPingJson
The class InvalidPingJson encapsulates the invalid ping data information received from device CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.Meta
The class Meta encapsulates the connection status information and additional messages sent from the server CryoDeviceProxy.PingPacketCryoDeviceProxy.BLL.PingRequestJson
The class PingRequestJson encapsulates ping data sent to the device if the serial number and imei number are available CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.PingResponseJson
The class PingResponseJson encapsulates the response from the server CryoDeviceProxy.ProgramCryoDeviceProxy.StartupOptions
The class StartupOptions has all the fields corresponding to the parameters defined in the startup_settings.json file. CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.UIData
The class UIData encapsulates the response sent from the server for the get-info request from the user interface CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.UIMeta
The class UIMeta encapsulates the additional connection status information from the server CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.UiProxyRequestJson
The class UiProxyRequestJson encapsulates request to be sent to the server. Not used in this version. CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.UiProxyResponseJson
The class UiProxyResponseJson encapsulates the information received from server CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.UpdateErrorListRequestJson
The class UpdateErrorListRequestJson encapsulates the error list data that needs to be sent to the server CryoDeviceProxy.BLL.UpdateUsageStatsListRequestJson
The class UpdateUsageStatsListRequestJson encapsulates the usage statistics list information to be sent to the server CryoDeviceProxy.Utils
